title: What to say to a recruiter on LinkedIn if you're NOT interested
description: What do you say back to a recruiter who reaches out if you’re not interested in the company or the role? We have a script for that. (Head to the Teal Job Tracker for a version you can copy and paste.) Bonus: Add the recruiter to your Contacts Tracker so you can reach back out down the line. More recruiter scripts in the videos on our page. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #shorts
